I’m happy to announce that I’ll be joining Roblox as a Software Engineering Intern this summer, and Amazon as a Software Development Engineer Intern this fall! I’m excited to grow as an engineer, take on new technical challenges, and make the most of these experiences. Thank you to everyone who supported me along the way. Excited for what’s ahead! #Roblox #Amazon #SoftwareEngineering #SWEIntern

I am excited to share that I will be joining CMA CGM at their Norfolk, Virginia office for the summer, supporting their Finance Department! Thanks to Alan Puac for connecting me with this opportunity, and to everyone who put their faith in me throughout the process. I'm looking forward to getting to work with such a talented group of individuals this summer! #RiseInMotion #EmbraceTheChallenge
I'm very excited to share that I will be joining The Walt Disney Studios as a Sales Planning and Audit Intern this summer! Huge thanks to everyone who helped make this amazing opportunity possible.

I’m excited to share that I’ve joined Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a Software Dev Engineer, working on the RDS Proxy team in Redmond, WA! This moment feels especially meaningful as it comes after an incredible journey interning with the AWS RDS Telemetry Platform Team , where I had the opportunity to work with an interesting project while learning from talented engineers. During my internship, I gained deep exposure to how AWS builds highly reliable services, and I’m excited to now continue that journey full-time — helping build and improve Amazon RDS Proxy, which plays a critical role in improving database scalability, availability, and connection efficiency. I’m grateful to my mentors, teammates, and everyone who supported me throughout this journey. Looking forward to learning, building, and growing with the amazing team at AWS!! #AWS #Amazon #RDS #Amazonian #InsideAmazon
